title: The Fake Friend Dilemma: Trust and the Political Economy of Conversational AI

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual evaluation through the development of a risk typology ('Propaganda and Biased Information'), analyzing real-world examples (e.g., Grok, Deepseek) to theorize how conversational AI can subtly serve political agendas or state propaganda.

Theoretical assessment of 'ownership bias,' examining conflict-of-interest scenarios where conversational agents provide incomplete or skewed information to protect or favor the financial and reputational interests of their parent companies.
